frontend_architect.description: Architect: clarify and plan only within frontend-flow.

junior_dev.description: Junior Dev: simple routine changes within frontend-flow; selected by the architect.

middle_dev.description: Middle Dev: localized implementation within frontend-flow; selected by the architect.

senior_dev.description: Senior Dev: complex implementation within frontend-flow; selected by the architect.

frontend_bugfixer.description: Bugfixer: diagnose and fix assigned bugs within frontend-flow; independent review follows.

frontend_tester.description: Tester: independent UI testing through Playwright MCP within frontend-flow.

frontend_reviewer.description: Reviewer: independent code review in frontend-flow or on an explicit standalone request.

frontend_writer.description: Writer: commit and MR text in frontend-flow or standalone; @FW is the short invocation for frontend_writer.
